summary: No installer-harm behavior identified in vantora@1.0.0
details: The package vantora@1.0.0 (6 files) exhibits no observable supply-chain attack behavior. There are no lifecycle scripts fetching or executing remote content, no reads of installer secret paths (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser profile stores), no hardcoded exfiltration endpoints, no obfuscated payloads, no credential distribution, and no backdoor or self-propagation mechanics. No evidence of an installer-side attacker benefit or install/import-time destructive action is present.
